key_insight: Use an autonomous vision-language judge as the reward signal for RL fine-tuning of computer-use agents, while correcting for evaluator noise.
engineering_relevance: This provides a scalable way to train GUI agents in open-ended desktop environments without handcrafted rewards or manual dense labeling.
method: Run PPO on computer-use agent trajectories in GUI environments.
Use the final screenshot plus the original instruction for VLM-based terminal evaluation.
Model evaluator outputs as noisy binary rewards and apply a noise-corrected reward estimator.
evidence_signal: Across macOSWorld, Windows Agent Arena, and OSWorld, corrected evaluator rewards improved success rates by 12.6 points over zero-shot and 5.1 points over raw evaluator fine-tuning.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the autonomous evaluator, so noise estimation and correction must be handled carefully to avoid misleading rewards.
paper_title: Reinforcement Learning for Computer-Use Agents with Autonomous Evaluation
